scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Disability percentage must be at least 40%
Applicant must be a person with disability (e.g., visually handicapped, low vision, hearing impaired, orthopedically handicapped, etc.)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,50,000, with 80% provided as a bank loan and 20% subsidy up to ₹30,000.
